Thievul

Dark

Galar · Generation 8

Thievul is a Dark-type Fox Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 19.9 kg. It evolves from Nickit. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (92), with a base stat total of 455.
